메모: 시즌3 블프 세일 「힘껏」 15초 — 시댄스 2.5 1일 무제한 웹 판 지시문(2026-10-31, 생성기 ../시댄스지시문.py). 시작 그림은 확정 정지컷의 글자 없는 사진 판(git 밖 콘티/bf-sale/시댄스/에 모음 — ⑬은 내리기 전 원판, 생성기 머리말). 영상 컷은 ① ③ ④ ⑥ ⑦ ⑧ ⑩ ⑫ ⑬아래 아홉이고 ② 글자 카드 · ⑨ ⑪ 제품 칸 · ⑬ 위 끝 카드 · 전광판 카운트다운 · 간판 글자 · ⑧ 제품 카드는 모션그래픽(후반). 카메라는 02 2절 「카메라 줄」 (원본 0.04초 실측) 숫자 그대로, 고정은 원본이 정말 그 자리인 ③ · ⑬ 휙 앞과, 들어오는 휙을 편집 이음으로 옮긴 ⑫ 주판(s3-12b — 시작 그림이 휙이 끝난 자리, 11-01 Fable P1)뿐. 11-01 Fable 검수(P1 2 · P2 5 · P3 4) 반영. 말은 모두 화면 밖 내레이션이라 소리 끔 · 입 맞춤 없음. 6초 판은 15초 판 판에서 잘라 쓴다(새 판 없음). 꾸러미는 ../../../시댄스무제한/웹꾸러미.py.

공통.장르: a premium, high-energy Korean sportswear commercial set in a neon spin studio

누구.CHAEWON: the same young Korean woman (Chaewon) as in the first frame, in every frame — a short black pixie cut with light bangs, faint freckles, an athletic build; a fitted orange-red half-zip long-sleeve training top, black high-waisted leggings, white sneakers; a thin black headset with a small boom mic in front of her mouth, worn exactly as in the first frame. She is the only person in the studio. She never speaks.
누구.STUDIO: the dark navy-violet spin studio of the first frame — rows of empty white spin bikes along both sides, thin vertical light strips on the walls, a large blank dark screen on the back wall that stays plain and dark, showing nothing.

공통.보기: LOOK: a premium, high-energy sportswear commercial — crisp cinema camera, deep navy-violet darkness with saturated orange-red, amber and pink neon, glossy reflections, natural skin texture, fine film grain, natural motion blur. Keep the first frame's light, colors and white balance to the very end; the light changes only where ACTION says so. Never add a person — Chaewon is the only person, and every other bike stays empty. Screens and signs stay plain and blank. No new text, letters, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.
공통.소리: SOUND: silent clip — no dialogue, no narration, no music.

판.설명: ① 스튜디오 정면 와이드 — 웃으며 페달, 0.8초 오른손 「가자」 손짓 · 천천히 6% 다가감(전광판 카운트다운은 후반)

샷.동작: Front view straight down the middle of the dark spin studio: Chaewon rides the white spin bike in the center on the orange-red mat runner, pedaling at a brisk, steady rhythm and grinning at the camera. At about 0.8 s she lifts her right hand (on the left side of the picture) off the handlebar and throws it up beside her head in an energetic, open-palm come-on wave, still pedaling and smiling, lips apart in a grin; her other hand stays on the handlebar.
샷.카메라: The camera physically moves straight forward toward her at a slow, perfectly even pace from the first frame — by 0.96 s it is about 6% closer, the walls, the dark screen and the rows of bikes all a little larger — and it keeps that same slow, even push to the end. Camera height stays exactly the same; no pan, no tilt, no shake.

판.설명: ③ 바닥 낮은 카메라 — 빛 고리(0–0.16초) → 큰 두루마리가 왼쪽 아래 가장자리에서 렌즈 바로 앞으로 들어와 오른쪽으로 굴러(원본 그대로) 0.32초 화면을 채우고 0.4초 다 펼쳐짐 · 거의 그대로, 끝 0.36초 아주 작은 틸트 업. 뒤 오른쪽 작은 두루마리는 그 자리(멀리서 굴러오게 하면 0.16초 만에 못 옴 — 11-01 Fable P2)

샷.동작: A low view from the glossy floor of the dark violet studio — no people. In the upper-left corner, the white edge of a spin bike's wheel guard; along the far wall, a glowing magenta line; at the back on the right, a rolled-up orange-red exercise mat lies on the floor. From the first frame big glowing orange-and-pink light rings swirl fast in circles just above the floor. At about 0.16 s the rings fade out as a big rolled-up orange-red mat shoots in from the lower-left edge, right in front of the lens, and rolls fast across the frame to the right, unrolling flat as it goes; at about 0.32 s the roll fills the frame for an instant as a dark orange blur, and by about 0.4 s the mat lies fully flat across the whole floor in front of the camera, its far edge running diagonally toward the back wall. The small rolled mat at the back on the right stays where it is. No person and no hand ever enters the frame. Then everything is still.
샷.카메라: The camera lies on the floor: the frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame — the wheel edge, the floor and the glowing line on the wall never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no shake — except that from about 0.4 s to 0.76 s it tilts up very slightly, so the glowing line on the far wall sinks by about 2% of the frame height, and then it holds.

판.설명: ④ 놀란 얼굴(O) 미디엄 클로즈업 — 시작 그림이 이미 위 오른쪽을 보는 O라(원본 3.04~3.36도 위 오른쪽) 고개는 그대로, 0.1초 눈썹 · 눈만 더 · 0.2초 왼쪽 팬 → 0.36초 왼쪽 아래로 휙(0.52초 오른쪽 위로 빠짐)

샷.동작: A medium close-up of Chaewon's face in soft lavender studio light, a blurred spin bike behind her on the right: she stares up and to the right — toward the upper-right corner of the picture, exactly where her eyes point in the first frame — eyes wide, mouth open in a round "O" of astonishment; her head does not turn. At about 0.1 s her eyebrows jump a little higher and her eyes widen even more; then she freezes in that astonished look — the "O" stays still, she does not talk.
샷.카메라: Handheld: almost still for the first 0.2 s, with only a slight tremble in place. From 0.2 s the camera starts panning to the left and speeds up, and from 0.36 s it whips away down to the left — so fast that she streaks out through the upper-right corner of the frame by 0.52 s in horizontal motion blur; the whip carries the camera onto a blurred stretch of the violet studio wall, where it comes to rest and holds to the end.

판.설명: ⑥ 정면 와이드 돌리 줌(채원 크기 그대로 · 뒷벽 화면 0.77배, 1.2초부터 느린 밀기로 풀림) · 외침(소리 없음) · 매트 두루마리가 카메라 쪽으로 굴러 다 펼쳐짐(0.56초) — 간판 글자는 후반. 시험 판정: 첫 1초에 채원 크기 ±5% · 뒷벽 화면이 15% 넘게 줄면 통과, 채원만 커지면(그냥 밀기) 06b, 06b도 같으면 ①과 같은 느린 밀기 판으로 내고 결정 표에 「돌리 줌 못 함」 한 줄

샷.동작: Front wide of the dark spin studio: Chaewon rides in the center, both hands on the handlebar, pedaling hard, and cheers toward the camera — mouth wide open in a big joyful shout (silent, no words). At the near end of the orange-red mat runner, the rolled-up end lying at the bottom of the frame rolls toward the camera and out of the bottom edge, so by about 0.56 s the whole mat lies flat. The big dark screen on the back wall stays plain and blank.
샷.카메라: Dolly zoom from the first frame, at an even pace: the camera physically moves forward toward her while zooming out at the same time, so Chaewon and her bike keep exactly the same size and place, while the back wall and the dark screen shrink and sink a little — by 0.72 s the screen is about 0.77 of its first size — and the side walls, the rows of bikes and the mat stretch outward and grow, so the room seems to open up wider and deeper around her. The same move continues at the same pace until about 1.2 s; then it eases off into a very slow, steady push and the room keeps its new wider look to the end. Smooth, no shake.

판.설명: ⑦ 뒷모습 — 빛 아치로 빨라지며 밀고 들어감(양 끝 자전거 0.24초에 빠짐) · 0.4초 아치 안이 하얗게 터짐(⑧로 이음)

샷.동작: Seen from behind in the dark studio, Chaewon pedals hard on her white spin bike down the glowing orange runner toward the tall orange-red neon arch — three nested rounded-rectangle frames of light — with rows of empty bikes along both edges. At about 0.4 s the inside of the arch flares into pure white light that spreads outward until, by about 0.6 s, the middle of the frame is almost all glowing white around her dark silhouette.
샷.카메라: The camera physically moves forward behind her toward the arch, speeding up — fastest between about 0.24 s and 0.48 s, easing very slightly in the last 0.1 s: the nearest bikes at both edges slide past the camera and out of the frame by 0.24 s while the rows further ahead stay along the edges, her back grows larger, and the arch grows until its glow fills most of the frame. The horizon stays perfectly level; no tilt, no shake. The forward move continues to the end.

판.설명: ⑧ 빛 터널 옆모습 질주 — 0.3–0.9초 고르게 0.82배로 물러나며 오른쪽으로 비켜 감(채원 오른쪽 가운데 → 왼쪽 가운데) · 터널은 계속 흐름(떠 지나가는 제품 카드는 후반)

샷.동작: Inside a tunnel of glowing orange and pink neon frames whose floor glows bright pink-white, Chaewon, seen from the side, pedals hard on her white spin bike facing right, leaning over the handlebar with a focused face, mouth closed; the neon frames and the light streaks on the floor rush past behind her from right to left the whole time, as if she is racing through the tunnel.
샷.카메라: Side tracking shot, camera perfectly level — the bike, her body and the neon frames stay upright. For the first 0.3 s it is almost still. From 0.3 s to 0.9 s the camera physically moves back away from her at an even pace while sliding a little to the right, so she shrinks to about 0.82 of her size and drifts left from just right of center to just left of center (about 15% of the frame width); it eases to a stop by 1.0 s and then holds that framing to the end while the tunnel keeps rushing past. No shake.

판.설명: ⑩ 놀람 O → 0.76초 웃음 — 카메라는 원본 방향 그대로 왼쪽으로(원본 25% · 얼굴 왼쪽 1/4 → 가운데), 확정 그림의 얼굴이 이미 가운데(0.50)라 얼굴 0.50 → 오른쪽 1/3(약 15%, 프레임 안) · 0.52초 멈춤 · 뒤 네온은 거꾸로 왼쪽으로 흘러 원본의 엇갈리는 움직임 그대로(11-01 Fable P2)

샷.동작: A close-up of Chaewon against bright red neon zigzag lines: mouth open in a round "O" of surprise, eyes wide, gaze exactly as in the first frame. She holds the astonished "O" — no talking — and at about 0.76 s it melts into a big, toothy smile.
샷.카메라: Handheld close-up: from the first frame to 0.52 s the camera drifts sideways to the left at an even pace and eases to a stop, so her face slides from the center to the right third of the frame (about 15% of the frame width), staying the same size and fully inside the frame; then it holds there with only a slight handheld tremble in place. Behind her the red neon lines keep streaming to the left on their own — fast at first, slower after 0.5 s.

판.설명: ⑫ 휘둘러 들어와 멈춘 옆모습 — 화면 고정 판(0.24초 고개 휙 · 0.56초 위를 보며 웃음), 들어오는 휙(원본 11.72~12.08)은 ⑤처럼 편집 이음 0.12~0.2초. 시작 그림이 휙이 끝난 자리라 화면 안에서 휘둘러 들어오게 하면 손 · 핸들이 오른쪽 밖으로 밀리고 끝 자리 글과 부딪혀(11-01 Fable P1) 이 판이 주판이다. 끝 프레임만 받는 판(12c)은 웹 카드가 그 모드를 받는지 몰라 만들지 않았다

샷.동작: Side view in the studio: Chaewon rides her white spin bike facing right, hands on the handlebar, gaze lifted slightly; stacked orange shopping boxes stand behind her on the left, and a blurred white towel hangs on a handlebar in the near foreground at the lower left. At about 0.24 s she snaps her head forward and leans in over the handlebar, pedaling hard from about 0.32 s; at about 0.56 s she lifts her face and bursts into an open-mouthed laugh, still pedaling.
샷.카메라: The frame stays exactly where it is from the first frame to the last — the boxes, the wall and the light strips never shift; no pan, no push-in, no zoom, no shake; only she moves.

판.설명: ⑬ 아래 — 카메라 보고 웃다 1.0–1.6초 주먹 쥐며 좋아함 · 1.8초까지 그 자리 → 오른쪽으로 휙 · 2.24초 빈 벽. 시작 그림은 정지컷 C13의 원천 C13t를 내리기 전 9:16 그대로(편집에서 550px 내려 끝 카드 밑에) — 6초 판 ⑬(고정 1.0초 → 휙 0.4초)도 이 판의 0.8초부터 잘라 쓴다

샷.동작: In the dark navy spin studio, Chaewon sits on her white spin bike on the right, hands resting on the handlebar, turned toward the camera and smiling warmly into the lens. From about 1.0 s to 1.6 s she clenches one fist and pumps it once or twice at chest height, delighted, then keeps grinning.
샷.카메라: From the first frame to 1.8 s the frame stays exactly where it is — the room, the bikes and the screen never shift; no push-in, no zoom, no shake. At 1.8 s the camera whips fast to the right, accelerating, so she and the bikes streak out to the left in horizontal motion blur; at about 2.24 s it stops on an empty stretch of the dark navy studio wall where one thin vertical light strip glows — no bikes, no objects, nothing written on it — and holds there to the end.

판.설명: ⑥ 대안 — 돌리 줌이 그냥 다가감 · 줌으로만 나올 때, 카메라 줄을 「기법 이름 + 끝 모습」 꼴로

샷.동작: Front wide of the dark spin studio: Chaewon rides in the center, both hands on the handlebar, pedaling hard, and cheers toward the camera — mouth wide open in a big joyful shout (silent, no words). At the near end of the orange-red mat runner, the rolled-up end lying at the bottom of the frame rolls toward the camera and out of the bottom edge, so by about 0.56 s the whole mat lies flat. The big dark screen on the back wall stays plain and blank.
샷.카메라: A fast, classic dolly zoom (the "Vertigo" effect) in the first second: Chaewon stays exactly the same size in the middle while the room stretches away behind her — by about 0.7 s the back wall and the screen have shrunk to about three-quarters of their size and the rows of bikes on both sides have swung outward and grown; then the move eases into a slow, steady push to the end. Smooth, no shake.

판.설명: ⑫ 대안 — 화면 안 휙을 보고 싶을 때만: 첫 장부터 왼쪽으로 휘둘러 6% 미끄러지며 0.36초에 멈춤(채원 오른쪽 1/3 · 손은 오른쪽 끝 안 — 핸들 그립은 가장자리를 넘을 수 있어 받은 뒤 확인), 판 머리에서 0.7초쯤 머무는 동안은 버리고 미끄러짐이 시작되는 장부터 쓴다

샷.동작: Side view in the studio: Chaewon rides her white spin bike facing right, hands on the handlebar, gaze lifted slightly; stacked orange shopping boxes stand behind her on the left, and a blurred white towel hangs on a handlebar in the near foreground at the lower left. At about 0.24 s she snaps her head forward and leans in over the handlebar, pedaling hard from about 0.32 s; at about 0.56 s she lifts her face and bursts into an open-mouthed laugh, still pedaling.
샷.카메라: A whip pan that lands on her: from the first frame the camera swings fast to the left, so the whole picture — boxes, light strips, the blurred towel in front and Chaewon — slides to the right by about 6% of the frame width in horizontal motion blur, braking hard and stopping dead at 0.36 s with her at the right third of the frame, her hands still inside the right edge. From 0.36 s the frame stays exactly where it is to the end — no push-in, no zoom, no drift, no shake; only she moves.
